Card Q&A.q: Can I use this card's effect to return Digimon that were already suspended to their owners' decks?

Effect: [When Digivolving] ＜Digi-Burst 4＞ (Trash 4 of this Digimon's digivolution cards to activate the effect below.)

・Suspend all of your opponent's Digimon with 5000 DP or less. Then, place all of your opponent's suspended Digimon at the bottom of their owners' decks in any order. Trash all of the digivolution cards of those Digimon.
